mpe_rules.name: Maximum Permissible Errors on Initial Verification (Table 6)
mpe_rules.condition: Initial verification or type evaluation under reference conditions

mpe_rules.name: MPE for net values and tare weighing devices
mpe_rules.rule: Maximum permissible errors apply to the net value for every possible tare load, except preset tare values. MPE for tare weighing device is identical to instrument MPE for same load value.

mpe_rules.name: Permissible difference for repeatability
mpe_rules.rule: Difference between results of several weighings of the same load <= |mpe| of the instrument for that load.

mpe_rules.name: Permissible error for eccentric loading
mpe_rules.rule: The error of indication at each eccentric position shall not exceed the maximum permissible error for the applied test load.

mpe_rules.name: Accuracy of zero setting
mpe_rules.rule: After zero setting, the effect of zero deviation on the result of the weighing shall be not more than +/- 0.25 e.

mpe_rules.name: Permissible variation for creep
mpe_rules.rule: Delta(0-30 min) <= 0.5 e AND Delta(15-30 min) <= 0.2 e. If not met, Delta(0-4 h) <= |mpe|.

mpe_rules.name: Permissible zero return deviation
mpe_rules.rule: Zero deviation after unloading a load kept on for 30 min shall not exceed 0.5 e (0.5 e1 for multi-interval).

mpe_rules.name: Limiting variation due to tilting
mpe_rules.rule: At no load: zero shift <= 2 e (except class II). At self-indication capacity & Max: error <= mpe.

mpe_rules.name: Temperature effect on no-load indication
mpe_rules.rule: Zero indication variation <= 1 e per 1 °C difference for Class I, and <= 1 e per 5 °C difference for Class II, III, IIII.

mpe_rules.name: Span stability error variation
mpe_rules.rule: Variation in errors of indication across measurements <= max(0.5 e, 0.5 |mpe|).

mpe_rules.name: Significant fault limit for disturbances
mpe_rules.rule: Difference between weight indication due to disturbance and intrinsic indication <= e, OR instrument detects and reacts to significant fault.

mpe_rules.name: Durability error after endurance test
mpe_rules.rule: Durability error (intrinsic error after 100 000 loadings minus initial intrinsic error) <= |mpe|.

mpe_rules.name: Sensitivity displacement for non-self-indicating instruments
mpe_rules.rule: Permanent displacement >= 1mm (Class I/II); >= 2mm (Class III/IIII, Max<=30kg); >= 5mm (Class III/IIII, Max>30kg).
